title: Invisible Cities - Calais
description: Homes built by refugees in the Calais camp, the “New Jungle”: 500,000 m² on the edge of the city, enclosed by a five-metre fence, with a range of housing types, both established and new. The series became Immorefugee, a property guide to the camp in the style of a holiday-let brochure, selected for the Kassel Photobook Award 2016.
